title: Bridal Seamless Sculpting Bodysuit | Ivory | Solid | Bridal | 78% Nylon, 22% Spandex bonded knit | Snap gusset
description:
Bridal shapewear fails in two predictable ways: it shows at the neckline, and it rolls at the waist. This bodysuit addresses both. The neckline sits low enough to stay under a scooped or V-back dress, and the waist is bonded rather than stitched so there is no horizontal band to roll.

The seams are bonded flat and the body is knit as a single piece, so nothing sits under a thin fabric. It has moderate shaping — enough to smooth under a dress, not enough to feel like a compression garment.

Also useful outside the wedding context: it works under a fitted jumpsuit or a wrap dress if you want smoothing without visible edges.

WHAT MAKES IT WORK
• Bonded seams — no stitching to show under thin fabric
• Low-cut back for V-back and scooped dresses
• Waist bonded rather than stitched, so it does not roll
• Moderate shaping, not a compression garment
• Knitted as a single piece for no visible join

DETAILS
• Material: 78% Nylon, 22% Spandex bonded knit
• Color: Ivory
• Closure: Snap gusset; no back closure
• Pattern: Solid
• Origin: Made in China
• Care: Hand wash cold. Line dry. Do not use chlorine bleach.

FIT & SIZING
True to size. The shaping is moderate — if you want firm compression for a dress with no stretch, size down one.
Model is 5'10" (178 cm) with a 36" bust and 28" waist, wearing size S.

Sizing tips:
• Measure your underbust — the band directly under the bust, snug but not tight. This matters more than the bust measurement for anything with a bodysuit fit.
• Measure your hip at the widest point, roughly 8 inches below the waist. This is the number most people underestimate.
• If you are between sizes, size up for sleepwear and lounge pieces, and size down for fitted bodysuits where you want a close fit.
• Fabric stretch varies by style. Each product page lists how much give the fabric has — styles listed as "about 2 inches of stretch" will size down more easily.
• Between a standard size and an extended size? Take the standard size. The jump to extended sizing changes torso length and gusset volume, not just the measurements.

QUESTIONS WE GET A LOT
Q: Will it show under my wedding dress?
A: That is what it is designed for. The seams are bonded flat, the body is knit as one piece, and the edges are finished thin enough to disappear under fitted fabric.

Q: Why is the back cut low?
A: So it stays put under V-back, scooped, or strapless dresses. A high back line would show above the dress edge.

Q: Does the waist roll like shapewear usually does?
A: No. The waist is bonded rather than stitched, so there is no horizontal band to roll when you sit or bend.

Q: How much shaping does this give?
A: Moderate — enough to smooth under a dress, not enough to feel like a compression garment. For a dress with no stretch at all, size down one for firmer control.
